passages.title: 鄰居家的冰毛巾
passages.text: Last Friday, I came home from school and put my hand in my bag. My {1} were not there! I rang the {2} three times, but nobody answered. Mom and Dad were still at work. It was hot, and I was very thirsty. Luckily, I had a {3} of water in my bag, so I sat down on the stairs and drank some. Then our neighbor, Mrs. Lee, opened her door. "Are you locked out?" she asked. She invited me in and gave me a cold {4} for my face. I did my homework at her table until Mom came home at six. That night, Mom gave me a new key on a long red string. "Wear it around your {5}," she said. "Then you can't forget it."

blanks.why: my keys were not there「我的鑰匙不見了」，所以進不了家門。clouds（雲）、tigers（老虎）、lessons（課）都不會放在書包裡用來開門。
ring the doorbell「按門鈴」。homework、river（河）、fever（發燒）都不能「按」來叫人開門。
a bottle of water「一瓶水」，口渴時拿出來喝。cloud、tiger、lesson 都不能用 a … of water 表示容器。
a cold towel for my face「一條擦臉的冰毛巾」。river、homework、cough 都不能拿來擦臉。
wear it around your neck「掛在脖子上」，就不會忘記。cloud、river、fever 都不是身體部位，不能掛鑰匙。

passages.zh: 上星期五，我放學回家，把手伸進書包——我的鑰匙不見了！我按了三次門鈴，都沒人應門，爸媽還在上班。天氣很熱，我很渴。幸好我書包裡有一瓶水，就坐在樓梯上喝了一些。這時候，鄰居李太太打開她家的門。「你被鎖在外面了嗎？」她問。她請我進去，還給我一條冰毛巾擦臉。我在她家的桌子上寫功課，一直等到媽媽六點回家。那天晚上，媽媽給我一把新鑰匙，綁在一條長長的紅繩上。「掛在脖子上，」她說，「這樣你就不會忘記了。」

passages.title: 神祕的門鈴聲
passages.text: For a whole week, our {1} rang every night at nine o'clock. But every time Dad opened the door, nobody was there. My little sister thought it was a ghost. She hid under her blanket and asked me to light a {2} in her room. "Ghosts don't like light," she said. On Friday night, Dad and I decided to catch the "ghost." We waited behind the door with a flashlight and a big {3} to throw over it. At nine o'clock, the bell rang. Dad opened the door fast, and we saw a small gray cat on the wall. It was jumping onto the bell button and then running away! Dad laughed so hard that he dropped his {4}. Now the cat comes every night, and we give it a little {5} of milk. It doesn't need to ring the doorbell anymore.

blanks.why: our doorbell rang「我們家的門鈴響了」，開門卻沒人。pencil、rainbow（彩虹）、lesson 都不會「響」。
light a candle「點一根蠟燭」，妹妹說鬼怕光。river、cough、homework 都不能點燃發光。
a big towel to throw over it「一條大毛巾，用來丟過去罩住」。rainbow、fever、lesson 都不能拿在手上丟。
drop his keys「把鑰匙掉在地上」。clouds、rivers、lessons 都不能拿在手上掉下去。
a little bottle of milk「一小瓶牛奶」。cloud、homework、fever 都不能裝牛奶。

passages.zh: 整整一個星期，我們家的門鈴每天晚上九點都會響，但爸爸每次開門，外面都沒有人。妹妹以為是鬼，她躲在毯子底下，叫我在她房間點一根蠟燭。「鬼不喜歡光。」她說。星期五晚上，爸爸和我決定抓住這個「鬼」。我們拿著手電筒和一條大毛巾躲在門後，準備把它罩住。九點一到，門鈴響了。爸爸飛快打開門，我們看到一隻灰色小貓站在牆上——牠跳到門鈴按鈕上，然後就跑走了！爸爸笑到把鑰匙都掉在地上。現在那隻貓每天晚上都會來，我們會給牠一小瓶牛奶，牠再也不用按門鈴了。

passages.title: 吹不熄的生日蠟燭
passages.text: For my twelfth birthday, my brother bought the cake. When Mom put twelve {1} on it and lit them, everyone sang "Happy Birthday." I made a wish and blew hard. All the flames went out, but two seconds later, they came back! I blew again. They came back again. My face turned red, and everyone laughed. Then I saw my brother laughing with a {2} of soda in his hand. "They're trick candles!" he said. I wanted to be angry, but I couldn't stop laughing. In the end, Dad put out the flames with a wet {3}. The next month, it was my brother's birthday. I hid a little toy frog in his gift box and rang the {4} before I ran away. When he opened the box, the frog jumped out. "Now we're even," I said, and I gave him the {5} to a real gift: a new bike lock.

blanks.why: put twelve candles on the cake「在蛋糕上插十二根蠟燭」。clouds、lessons、fevers 都不能插在蛋糕上點燃。
a bottle of soda「一瓶汽水」，哥哥拿在手上。rainbow、homework、tiger 都不能用 a … of soda 表示裝飲料的容器。
put out the flames with a wet towel「用濕毛巾把火弄熄」。river、cough、lesson 都不能拿在手上滅火。
ring the doorbell「按門鈴」，按完就跑。pencil、cloud、fever 都不能按。
the key to a bike lock「腳踏車鎖的鑰匙」。tiger、rainbow、homework 都不能打開鎖。

gloss: 魔術蠟燭（吹不熄的蠟燭）
passages.zh: 我十二歲生日時，蛋糕是哥哥買的。媽媽在蛋糕上插了十二根蠟燭並點燃，大家一起唱生日快樂歌。我許了願，用力一吹，火全滅了，但兩秒後又燒起來！我再吹，它們又亮了。我的臉都紅了，大家哈哈大笑。接著我看到哥哥手裡拿著一瓶汽水在笑。「這是吹不熄的魔術蠟燭啦！」他說。我想生氣，卻笑個不停。最後爸爸用一條濕毛巾把火弄熄了。下個月輪到哥哥生日，我在他的禮物盒裡藏了一隻玩具青蛙，按了門鈴就跑掉。他打開盒子，青蛙跳了出來。「這樣我們就扯平了。」我說，然後把真正禮物的鑰匙交給他：一個新的腳踏車鎖。

passages.title: 海鷗搶毛巾
passages.text: Last summer, my family spent a day at Fulong Beach. I put my new beach {1} on the sand and lay down in the sun. Mom gave me a {2} of cold green tea, and I fell asleep. Suddenly, I felt something pulling. A big seagull was flying away with my towel in its mouth! I jumped up and ran after it. People on the beach laughed and took pictures. Finally, the bird dropped the towel into the {3}. When I came back, another seagull was standing next to our bag, eating my {4}. "It played a trick on you," Dad said. "While you were running, its friend came for your lunch." Even worse, my car {5} was missing too. We looked everywhere and found it in the sand under the bag. From now on, I'll keep my things in a bag with a zipper.

blanks.why: my new beach towel「我的新海灘巾」，鋪在沙灘上躺。cloud、lesson、fever 都不能鋪在沙上。
a bottle of cold green tea「一瓶冰綠茶」。river、homework、tiger 都不能用 a … of 裝飲料。
drop the towel into the sea「把毛巾丟進海裡」，在海灘上。pencil、lesson、cough 都不能讓東西「掉進去」。
eating my sandwich「吃我的三明治」，後面說牠的朋友來吃午餐。rainbow、homework、fever 都不能吃。
my car key「我的車鑰匙」不見了，後來在沙子裡找到。pencil、rainbow、cough 都不能和 car 組成要找的重要東西。

passages.zh: 去年夏天，我們全家在福隆海灘玩了一天。我把新的海灘巾鋪在沙上，躺下來曬太陽。媽媽給我一瓶冰綠茶，我就睡著了。突然，我覺得有東西在拉——一隻大海鷗正叼著我的毛巾飛走！我跳起來追牠，海灘上的人都在笑、拍照。最後，那隻鳥把毛巾丟進海裡。我回來時，另一隻海鷗正站在我們的包包旁邊吃我的三明治。「牠捉弄了你，」爸爸說，「你在跑的時候，牠的朋友來吃你的午餐了。」更慘的是，車鑰匙也不見了。我們到處找，最後在包包底下的沙子裡找到。從現在起，我要把東西放在有拉鍊的袋子裡。

passages.title: 漂流到澎湖的瓶中信
passages.text: Two years ago, my class wrote letters to "a friend far away." We put each letter in a plastic {1}, closed it tightly, and threw it into the sea from Keelung. Most of us forgot about it. But last month, our teacher got a phone call. A fisherman in Penghu had found one of the bottles near his boat! The letter inside was from my classmate Ben. In it, Ben wrote about his dog and his favorite {2}, a big one that smelled like oranges. The fisherman sent us a photo of his family and a small gift: a {3} chain made from shells. He also sent a beach {4} with a map of Penghu on it. Ben was so excited that he rang our {5} at seven in the morning to show me. "My letter traveled across the sea!" he shouted. Now we want to visit Penghu and meet our new friend.

blanks.why: a plastic bottle「塑膠瓶」，把信裝進去丟進海裡。tiger、lesson、fever 都不能裝信、蓋緊。
his favorite candle, a big one that smelled like oranges「他最喜歡的蠟燭，聞起來有柳橙味」。river、cough、homework 都不會有柳橙香味。
a key chain「鑰匙圈」，用貝殼做的。rainbow、fever、lesson 都不能和 chain 組成小禮物。
a beach towel with a map on it「印著地圖的海灘巾」。pencil、cough、river 都不能「印」上澎湖地圖當禮物。
ring our doorbell「按我家門鈴」，一大早來給我看。tiger、homework、fever 都不能按。

passages.zh: 兩年前，我們班寫信給「遠方的朋友」。我們把每封信放進塑膠瓶，蓋緊後從基隆丟進海裡。大部分的人都忘了這件事。但上個月，老師接到一通電話：澎湖的一位漁夫在他的船邊找到了一個瓶子！裡面的信是我同學 Ben 寫的。Ben 在信裡寫了他的狗，還有他最喜歡的蠟燭——一根聞起來有柳橙味的大蠟燭。漁夫寄來一張他全家的照片和一份小禮物：一個用貝殼做的鑰匙圈。他還寄了一條印著澎湖地圖的海灘巾。Ben 興奮到早上七點就來按我家門鈴給我看。「我的信漂過大海了！」他大喊。現在我們很想去澎湖見見這位新朋友。

passages.title: 演唱會的應援毛巾
passages.text: My sister Jessie is a big fan of Nova, a K-pop girl group. Last weekend, she went to their concert in Taichung. Before she left, she packed her bag very carefully. She took a light stick, two {1} of water, and a slogan {2} with "NOVA" printed on it in pink letters. Fans hold up these towels when their favorite singers come on stage. During the concert, the singer Yuna looked right at Jessie's towel and waved. Jessie screamed so loudly that she lost her voice. She came home at midnight, but she forgot her house {3}. She didn't want to ring the {4} and wake everyone up, so she sent me a message. I went downstairs quietly and opened the door. "Thank you," she whispered. "Tomorrow I'll buy you a Nova {5}." I'm not a fan, but I said yes anyway.

blanks.why: two bottles of water「兩瓶水」。rainbows、lessons、fevers 都不能用 … of water 表示容器。
a slogan towel「應援毛巾」，上面印著團名，粉絲會舉起來。tiger、river、cough 都不能印字舉起來。
her house key「她家的鑰匙」忘了帶，所以進不了門。pencil、cloud、homework 都不能開門。
ring the doorbell「按門鈴」，怕吵醒大家。lesson、fever、river 都不能按。
a Nova candle「Nova 的周邊蠟燭」，要買給我當謝禮。tiger、cough、rainbow 都不能在店裡買來當禮物。

passages.zh: 我姊姊 Jessie 是韓國女團 Nova 的超級粉絲。上週末，她去台中看她們的演唱會。出門前，她很仔細地整理包包：帶了一支應援棒、兩瓶水，還有一條用粉紅色字印著「NOVA」的應援毛巾。當喜歡的歌手上台時，粉絲就會把毛巾舉起來。演唱會上，歌手 Yuna 正好看著 Jessie 的毛巾揮手。Jessie 尖叫得太大聲，聲音都啞了。她半夜才回家，卻忘了帶家裡的鑰匙。她不想按門鈴吵醒大家，所以傳訊息給我。我安靜地下樓幫她開門。「謝謝你，」她小聲說，「明天我買一個 Nova 的蠟燭送你。」我不是她們的粉絲，但還是答應了。

passages.title: 爸媽的燭光晚餐
passages.text: Last Saturday was my parents' fifteenth wedding anniversary. My brother and I wanted to surprise them. While they were out shopping, we cooked spaghetti and made a salad. Then we turned off the lights and put six {1} on the dining table. We also put a {2} of grape juice in the middle. My brother put a white {3} over his arm like a waiter in a fancy restaurant. At seven o'clock, we heard Dad's {4} at the door. "Why is it so dark in here?" Mom asked. Then she saw the table and smiled. Dinner was a little salty, but my parents said it was the best meal ever. After dinner, the {5} rang. It was Grandma with a big cake. "I knew you two had a plan," she said with a wink.

blanks.why: put six candles on the table「在餐桌上放六根蠟燭」，關燈後當燭光晚餐。rivers、lessons、coughs 都不能放在桌上點。
a bottle of grape juice「一瓶葡萄汁」。tiger、pencil、fever 都不能用 a … of juice 表示容器。
a white towel over his arm「把白毛巾掛在手臂上」，像高級餐廳的服務生。homework、cloud、cough 都不能掛在手臂上。
hear Dad's keys at the door「聽到爸爸在門口拿鑰匙的聲音」。rivers、tigers、fevers 都不會在門口發出聲音。
the doorbell rang「門鈴響了」，是阿嬤來了。lesson、pencil、rainbow 都不會響。

passages.zh: 上星期六是爸媽結婚十五週年紀念日，我和哥哥想給他們一個驚喜。趁他們出去買東西時，我們煮了義大利麵、做了沙拉，然後關掉燈，在餐桌上放了六根蠟燭，中間還擺了一瓶葡萄汁。哥哥把一條白毛巾掛在手臂上，像高級餐廳的服務生。七點時，我們聽到爸爸在門口拿鑰匙的聲音。「這裡怎麼這麼暗？」媽媽問。接著她看到餐桌，笑了。晚餐有點鹹，但爸媽說這是他們吃過最棒的一餐。晚餐後，門鈴響了，是阿嬤帶著一個大蛋糕來。「我就知道你們兩個有計畫。」她眨眨眼說。

passages.title: 門鈴鏡頭拍到的小偷
passages.text: Our house is near a mountain in Kaohsiung. Last month, Dad put a smart {1} with a camera on our front door. It sends a video to his phone when someone comes near. One afternoon, his phone beeped. In the video, a small monkey was standing at our door! It looked into the camera, picked up a {2} of milk from the delivery box, and ran away. The next day, it came back and took the beach {3} that was drying on our {4}. On the third day, it tried to take Mom's car {5} from the table on the porch! Dad shouted through the doorbell speaker, "Hey! Stop that!" The monkey jumped, dropped the keys, and ran into the trees. Now we keep everything inside. But my sister still wants to give the monkey a name. She calls it "the little thief."

blanks.why: a smart doorbell with a camera「有鏡頭的智慧門鈴」，有人靠近就傳影片。lesson、river、fever 都不能裝在門上拍影片。
a bottle of milk「一瓶牛奶」，從送貨箱裡拿走。tiger、homework、cough 都不能用 a … of milk 表示容器。
the beach towel「海灘巾」，可以晾乾、被猴子拿走。pencil、fever、rainbow 都不能晾乾。
drying on our gate「晾在我們家大門上」。lesson、cough、river 都不能拿來晾東西。
Mom's car keys「媽媽的車鑰匙」，後面也說猴子丟下鑰匙。clouds、lessons、coughs 都不能放在桌上被拿走。

passages.zh: 我們家在高雄的山邊。上個月，爸爸在大門裝了一個有鏡頭的智慧門鈴，有人靠近就會傳影片到他的手機。有一天下午，他的手機嗶嗶響。影片裡，一隻小猴子站在我們家門口！牠看著鏡頭，從送貨箱裡拿起一瓶牛奶就跑了。隔天牠又來了，拿走晾在大門上的海灘巾。第三天，牠竟然想拿走門廊桌上媽媽的車鑰匙！爸爸透過門鈴的喇叭大喊：「喂！住手！」猴子嚇了一跳，丟下鑰匙跑進樹林。現在我們把所有東西都收進屋裡。但妹妹還是想幫那隻猴子取名字，她叫牠「小偷」。

passages.title: 送錯門的珍珠奶茶
passages.text: On Sunday afternoon, I ordered two cups of bubble tea online. Twenty minutes later, our {1} rang. I ran to the door, but the delivery man wasn't there. Then I heard a bell ringing next door. He was at the wrong house! I went out and saw our neighbor, Mr. Chang, holding my bubble tea. "Did you order this?" he asked. "I don't drink {2} drinks. I only drink water from my {3}." We both laughed. Mr. Chang gave me the drinks, and I gave him a cookie to say thanks. When I went back home, I found that the door was locked. My {4} were inside! I had to wait for Mom for an hour. It was hot, so I wiped my face with a small {5} from my pocket. By the time Mom came home, the ice in my bubble tea was gone. Next time, I'll write the right address and take my keys!

blanks.why: our doorbell rang「我家門鈴響了」。pencil、river、cough 都不會響。
sweet drinks「甜的飲料」，珍奶是甜的，張先生不喝。honest（誠實的）、lazy（懶惰的）、polite（有禮貌的）都是形容人，不能形容飲料。
water from my bottle「從我的水瓶裡喝水」。tiger、lesson、fever 都不能裝水。
my keys were inside「我的鑰匙在屋子裡」，所以進不去。rivers、coughs、lessons 都不能開門。
wipe my face with a small towel「用小毛巾擦臉」。homework、rainbow、fever 都不能擦臉。

passages.zh: 星期天下午，我在網路上訂了兩杯珍珠奶茶。二十分鐘後，我家門鈴響了。我跑去開門，外送員卻不在。接著我聽到隔壁的電鈴聲——他送錯家了！我走出去，看到鄰居張先生拿著我的珍奶。「這是你訂的嗎？」他問，「我不喝甜的飲料，我只喝我水瓶裡的水。」我們都笑了。張先生把飲料給我，我給他一塊餅乾當謝禮。回家時，我發現門鎖上了，我的鑰匙在屋子裡！我只好等媽媽等了一個小時。天氣很熱，我用口袋裡的小毛巾擦臉。等到媽媽回來，我珍奶裡的冰都融化了。下次我會寫對地址，也會帶好鑰匙！

passages.title: 冠軍賽的毛巾與水瓶
passages.text: Our school basketball team made it to the final game. My job was easy, but it was important. I was the team helper. Before the game, I filled twelve water {1} and put a clean {2} on every player's chair. During the game, the players were hot and tired. Every time they came to the bench, I gave them water and towels. At half time, we were losing by ten points. Our coach said, "Don't give up. You are a team. Play together!" In the second half, our team played much better. With five seconds left, Kevin threw the ball and scored. We won by one {3}! The players jumped up and down and threw their towels in the air. After the game, the coach gave me the {4} to the sports room. "You're part of this team too," he said. That night, Mom lit a {5} on a small cake for me. It was the best day of the year.

blanks.why: fill twelve water bottles「裝滿十二個水瓶」。tigers、rivers、lessons 都不能裝水。
a clean towel on every chair「每張椅子上放一條乾淨毛巾」，後面球員拿毛巾擦汗。pencil、cough、homework 都不能讓球員擦汗。
win by one point「贏一分」。tiger、cough、rainbow 都不能當比賽得分的單位。
the key to the sports room「體育器材室的鑰匙」。fever、rainbow、lesson 都不能打開房間。
light a candle on a cake「在蛋糕上點一根蠟燭」慶祝。river、tiger、cough 都不能放在小蛋糕上點。

passages.zh: 我們學校籃球隊打進了決賽。我的工作很簡單，但很重要：我是球隊的幫手。比賽前，我裝滿了十二個水瓶，並在每位球員的椅子上放一條乾淨的毛巾。比賽中，球員又熱又累，每次他們回到板凳區，我就遞上水和毛巾。中場休息時，我們落後十分。教練說：「不要放棄，你們是一個團隊，一起打！」下半場我們打得好多了。剩下五秒時，Kevin 投籃得分，我們贏了一分！球員們跳上跳下，把毛巾丟向空中。比賽結束後，教練把器材室的鑰匙交給我。「你也是這支隊伍的一份子。」他說。那天晚上，媽媽在一個小蛋糕上為我點了一根蠟燭。那是我一年中最棒的一天。

passages.title: 全班一起帶水瓶
passages.text: Every day, our school throws away hundreds of plastic {1}. Our science teacher, Mr. Lin, showed us a {2} of a sea turtle with plastic in its mouth. We all felt terrible. So our class started a "One Bottle Challenge." For one month, every student had to bring the same water bottle from home every day. Anyone who bought a plastic bottle had to clean the {3} after school. At first, some students forgot. Jack forgot three times and cleaned the room three times! But soon, everyone remembered. Some students even put stickers on their bottles. Amy hung a small {4} on hers so she could wipe it after drinking. At the end of the month, our class used 300 fewer plastic bottles. Mr. Lin gave us a prize: a big {5} made from old cooking oil. "Even small things can help the Earth," he said.

blanks.why: plastic bottles「塑膠瓶」，學校每天丟掉好幾百個。tigers、lessons、fevers 都不是會被丟掉的塑膠製品。
show us a photo of a sea turtle「給我們看一張海龜的照片」。cough、fever、monkey 都不能「給人看 … of a sea turtle」。
clean the classroom「打掃教室」，後面也說打掃了三次。river、cough、rainbow 都不能放學後打掃。
hang a small towel on her bottle「在水瓶上掛一條小毛巾」，喝完可以擦。pencil、fever、monkey 都不能拿來擦水瓶。
a big candle made from old cooking oil「用廢食用油做的蠟燭」。homework、river、cough 都不能用油做出來。

passages.zh: 我們學校每天丟掉好幾百個塑膠瓶。自然老師林老師給我們看一張海龜嘴裡卡著塑膠的照片，大家都很難過。所以我們班開始了「一瓶挑戰」：一個月內，每個學生每天都要從家裡帶同一個水瓶。誰買了塑膠瓶，放學後就要打掃教室。一開始有些同學會忘記，Jack 忘了三次，就打掃了三次教室！但很快地，大家都記得了。有些同學還在水瓶上貼貼紙，Amy 在她的水瓶上掛了一條小毛巾，喝完可以擦一擦。月底時，我們班少用了 300 個塑膠瓶。林老師送我們一個獎品：一根用廢食用油做的大蠟燭。「就算是小事，也能幫助地球。」他說。

passages.title: 阿公的鑰匙圈收藏
passages.text: My grandpa collects key chains. He has more than five hundred of them, and he keeps them in a big glass {1} in his living room. Each key chain has a story. There's a tiny Eiffel Tower from his trip to Paris and a little red lantern from Tainan. My favorite one is an old brass {2} that doesn't open anything. "This was the key to my first home," Grandpa told me. "That house is gone now, but I still have the key." Last Sunday, I gave him a new key chain as a {3}. It was a tiny {4} that could light up. He loved it. He put it in the bottle and said, "Now this one has a story too: my grandson gave it to me." Then he made me some hot tea and gave me a soft {5} because my hair was wet from the rain. I hope I can have a collection like his one day.

blanks.why: a big glass bottle「一個大玻璃罐」，用來裝鑰匙圈。tiger、lesson、cough 都不能裝東西放在客廳。
an old brass key that doesn't open anything「一把打不開任何東西的舊銅鑰匙」。river、fever、rainbow 都跟「打開」無關。
as a gift「當作禮物」。river、fever、tiger 都不能用 as a … 表示送東西的用途。
a tiny candle that could light up「會發光的小蠟燭（造型鑰匙圈）」。pencil、homework、monkey 都不會「發光」。
a soft towel for wet hair「一條柔軟的毛巾」擦被雨淋濕的頭髮。cookie、lesson、cough 都不能擦頭髮。

passages.zh: 我阿公收集鑰匙圈，他有五百多個，全都放在客廳一個大玻璃罐裡。每個鑰匙圈都有一個故事：有一個小小的艾菲爾鐵塔，是他去巴黎旅行時買的；還有一個小紅燈籠，來自台南。我最喜歡的是一把舊銅鑰匙，它什麼都打不開。「這是我第一個家的鑰匙，」阿公告訴我，「那棟房子已經不在了，但我還留著鑰匙。」上星期天，我送他一個新的鑰匙圈，是一根會發光的小蠟燭。他很喜歡，把它放進罐子裡說：「現在這個也有故事了：是我孫子送我的。」接著他幫我泡了熱茶，又給我一條柔軟的毛巾，因為我的頭髮被雨淋濕了。我希望有一天也能有像他那樣的收藏。

passages.title: 生日尋寶遊戲
passages.text: For my brother's tenth birthday, Mom made a treasure hunt. The first clue was under his pillow: "Look where we keep the {1}." He ran to the bathroom and found the second clue: "Go to the door, but don't open it. Look above the {2}." There, he found a small envelope with a third clue: "I am tall and thin. I give light, but I'm not a lamp." He thought for a moment. "A {3}!" He found the next clue next to the candle on the dining table. It said, "Look inside the green {4} in the kitchen." Inside the bottle was a tiny golden {5}. The key opened a box under the sofa, and inside the box was a new soccer ball. "Best birthday ever!" he shouted. Then he asked, "Can we do this again tomorrow?"

blanks.why: where we keep the towels「我們放毛巾的地方」，所以他跑去浴室。rivers、lessons、fevers 都不能放在浴室收納。
above the doorbell「在門鈴上方」，在門邊。homework、monkey、cough 都不會固定在門邊。
tall and thin, gives light but isn't a lamp「又高又細，會發光但不是燈」：蠟燭。tiger、pencil、cookie 都不會發光。
inside the green bottle「綠色瓶子裡面」，裡面裝著鑰匙。rainbow、lesson、fever 都不能裝東西。
a tiny golden key that opened a box「一把能打開盒子的小金鑰匙」。river、cough、homework 都不能開箱子。

passages.zh: 弟弟十歲生日時，媽媽設計了一個尋寶遊戲。第一個線索在他的枕頭下：「去找我們放毛巾的地方。」他跑到浴室，找到第二個線索：「走到門口，但不要開門，看看門鈴的上面。」他在那裡找到一個小信封，裡面是第三個線索：「我又高又細，會發光，但我不是燈。」他想了一下：「蠟燭！」他在餐桌上的蠟燭旁邊找到下一個線索：「看看廚房裡那個綠色瓶子的裡面。」瓶子裡有一把小小的金鑰匙。鑰匙打開了沙發底下的一個盒子，裡面是一顆新足球。「最棒的生日！」他大喊，接著問：「明天可以再玩一次嗎？」

passages.title: 會飛的鑰匙
passages.text: In the first Harry Potter book, Harry and his friends find a room full of flying {1}. They look like small birds with wings. Only one of them can open the next door, and Harry has to catch it on a broom. After reading this part, my friend Ivy had an idea for our class play. She made twenty paper keys and hung them from the ceiling with string. In the play, I was Harry. I used a mop as my broom and tried to catch the right key. Then something went wrong. I knocked over a {2} of water, and the {3} became wet. I slipped and fell, and the whole class laughed. Ivy threw me a {4}, and I cleaned the floor on stage. "Harry Potter never did this!" I said. Everyone laughed again. In the end, our teacher said our play was the most {5} one in the school. Maybe falling was a good idea after all.

blanks.why: a room full of flying keys「滿是飛行鑰匙的房間」，其中一把能打開下一道門。rivers、coughs、lessons 都不能打開門。
knock over a bottle of water「打翻一瓶水」，地板因此變濕。tiger、pencil、fever 都不能裝水打翻。
the floor became wet「地板變濕」，所以滑倒。rainbow、tiger、cough 都不能被水弄濕讓人滑倒。
throw me a towel「丟給我一條毛巾」擦地板。rainbow、homework、cough 都不能拿來擦地。
the most popular one「最受歡迎的一齣」。honest（誠實）、lazy（懶惰）、salty（鹹）都不能形容一齣戲受歡迎。

passages.zh: 在《哈利波特》第一集裡，哈利和朋友們發現一個滿是飛行鑰匙的房間，鑰匙長得像有翅膀的小鳥。只有其中一把能打開下一道門，哈利得騎著掃帚去抓它。讀完這段之後，我朋友 Ivy 想到一個班級話劇的點子。她做了二十把紙鑰匙，用繩子掛在天花板上。話劇裡我演哈利，拿拖把當掃帚，想要抓到正確的鑰匙。結果出了狀況：我打翻了一瓶水，地板變得濕濕的，我滑倒了，全班都笑了。Ivy 丟給我一條毛巾，我就在台上擦起地板。「哈利波特才不會做這種事！」我說，大家又笑了。最後，老師說我們的話劇是全校最受歡迎的。也許跌倒終究是個好主意。

passages.title: 萬聖節的南瓜燈
passages.text: Last Halloween, our English teacher, Ms. Wu, invited our class to her house. She lives in a small town in Hsinchu. Outside her door, there were three big pumpkins with funny faces. Inside each one, there was a little {1}, so the faces glowed in the dark. We wore costumes. I was a vampire, and my friend Joe was a mummy. He used ten white {2} to cover his whole body! When we got to the house, Joe rang the {3} and shouted, "Trick or treat!" Ms. Wu opened the door and screamed. Then she laughed and gave each of us a {4} of orange juice and a bag of candy. Later, Joe's towels started falling off. By the end of the night, he was a mummy with no clothes on his legs. "I'm a {5} mummy," he said. "I'm too tired to keep my towels on."

blanks.why: a little candle inside each pumpkin「每個南瓜裡放一根小蠟燭」，臉才會在黑暗中發光。river、lesson、cough 都不能放在南瓜裡發光。
ten white towels to cover his body「用十條白毛巾包住全身」扮木乃伊。tigers、fevers、rainbows 都不能包住身體。
ring the doorbell「按門鈴」，說「不給糖就搗蛋」。pencil、rainbow、cough 都不能按。
a bottle of orange juice「一瓶柳橙汁」。monkey、lesson、fever 都不能裝果汁。
a lazy mummy「懶惰的木乃伊」，累到毛巾都懶得綁好。sweet、salty、sour 都是味道，不能形容人。

passages.zh: 去年萬聖節，英文老師吳老師邀請我們班去她家。她住在新竹的一個小鎮。她家門外有三顆刻著好笑表情的大南瓜，每顆南瓜裡面都放著一根小蠟燭，所以臉會在黑暗中發光。我們都穿了扮裝：我扮吸血鬼，我朋友 Joe 扮木乃伊，他用十條白毛巾把全身包起來！我們到了她家，Joe 按了門鈴大喊：「不給糖就搗蛋！」吳老師開門時尖叫了一聲，接著笑了，給我們每人一瓶柳橙汁和一袋糖果。後來，Joe 的毛巾開始掉下來，到了晚上結束時，他變成一個腿上什麼都沒包的木乃伊。「我是一個懶惰的木乃伊，」他說，「我累到懶得把毛巾綁好了。」

passages.title: 浴室裡的求救聲
passages.text: Last night, my dad took a long shower. When he finished, he looked around and found no {1} in the bathroom. "Help!" he called. "Can someone bring me a towel?" But nobody heard him. Mom was talking on the phone, and my sister was singing K-pop songs in her room. Just then, the {2} rang. It was a delivery man with a big box. "Can someone open the door?" Dad shouted from the bathroom. Still, nobody heard him. In the end, I opened the door and took the box. Inside was a pack of six new towels that Mom had ordered online! I laughed and threw one over the bathroom door. Dad came out, holding a {3} of shampoo. "Next time," he said, "I'll keep a towel in the bathroom all the time." Mom smiled and gave him the {4} to the cabinet. "The towels have always been in here," she said. "You just never {5}."

blanks.why: found no towel in the bathroom「浴室裡沒有毛巾」，所以大喊求救。pencil、lesson、tiger 都不是洗完澡要用的東西。
the doorbell rang「門鈴響了」，是送貨員。river、cough、homework 都不會響。
a bottle of shampoo「一瓶洗髮精」。tiger、fever、rainbow 都不能裝洗髮精。
the key to the cabinet「櫃子的鑰匙」。cough、monkey、lesson 都不能打開櫃子。
you never looked「你從來沒看過（那裡）」。cried、slept、arrived 都和「沒發現毛巾在櫃子裡」意思不合。

passages.zh: 昨天晚上，爸爸洗了很久的澡。洗完後他四處看，發現浴室裡沒有毛巾。「救命啊！」他大喊，「誰可以拿一條毛巾給我？」但沒人聽到。媽媽在講電話，姊姊在房間唱韓國歌。就在這時，門鈴響了，是送貨員送來一個大箱子。「誰可以去開門？」爸爸在浴室裡喊，還是沒人聽到。最後是我去開門、收了箱子。裡面竟然是媽媽在網路上訂的一組六條新毛巾！我笑著丟一條到浴室門上。爸爸拿著一瓶洗髮精走出來說：「下次我一定要在浴室放一條毛巾。」媽媽笑著把櫃子的鑰匙交給他：「毛巾一直都放在這裡面，只是你從來沒看過。」

passages.title: 寶特瓶火箭比賽
passages.text: In science class, Mr. Huang told us to make rockets out of plastic {1}. Each group used one big bottle, some water, and a bicycle pump. My group worked hard for a week. We drew fire on our rocket and gave it a name: "Sky Monkey." On the day of the contest, we went to the school field. We filled the bottle with water, and Mr. Huang pumped air into it. Three, two, one! Our rocket shot into the sky and flew over the school {2}! Everyone cheered. But then it fell onto the roof of a house across the street. We had to ring the {3} of that house and say sorry. An old man came out, laughing. "That's the best thing that has fallen on my roof in years," he said. He climbed up and brought it back for us. Our rocket was wet, so we dried it with a {4}. We didn't win first place, but our rocket was the most {5} one.

blanks.why: rockets out of plastic bottles「用寶特瓶做火箭」。tigers、coughs、lessons 都不能做成火箭。
flew over the school gate「飛過學校大門」。fever、homework、rainbow 都不是學校裡固定、能被飛越的建築。
ring the doorbell of that house「按那戶人家的門鈴」道歉。pencil、river、cough 都不能按。
dry it with a towel「用毛巾擦乾」。lesson、tiger、fever 都不能擦乾東西。
the most popular one「最受歡迎的一個」，因為大家都為它歡呼。bitter、sour、salty 都是味道，不能形容火箭。

passages.zh: 自然課時，黃老師要我們用寶特瓶做火箭。每組用一個大瓶子、一些水和一支腳踏車打氣筒。我們這組努力了一個星期，在火箭上畫了火焰，還取了名字：「天空猴子號」。比賽那天，我們到學校操場，把瓶子裝了水，黃老師幫忙打氣。三、二、一！我們的火箭衝上天空，飛過了學校大門！大家都歡呼起來。但接著它掉到對面一戶人家的屋頂上。我們只好去按那戶人家的門鈴道歉。一位老先生笑著走出來：「這是好幾年來掉到我屋頂上最棒的東西。」他爬上去幫我們拿下來。火箭濕了，我們用毛巾把它擦乾。我們沒有得到第一名，但我們的火箭是最受歡迎的。

passages.title: 通往另一個世界的門鈴
passages.text: On the way home from school, Lily noticed a strange blue door between two shops. She had never seen it before. There was a golden {1} next to it. She pressed it, and the door opened by itself. Inside was a {2} full of glowing trees. A small fox in a red hat walked up to her. "Welcome!" it said. "We've been waiting for you. Our forest is dark because the Moon Candle went out. Only a human can light it again." The fox gave her a silver {3} and led her to a tall tower. Lily opened the door with the key and climbed the stairs. At the top, there was a huge {4}. She lit it with a match, and the whole forest became bright. The animals cheered. The fox gave her a tiny glass {5} full of moonlight as a thank-you gift. When Lily walked out, she was back on the street, and the blue door was gone.

blanks.why: a golden doorbell next to the door「門旁邊有一個金色門鈴」，按下去門就開了。river、cough、lesson 都不能按。
a forest full of glowing trees「滿是發光樹木的森林」。cough、lesson、fever 都不能「充滿樹木」。
a silver key「一把銀鑰匙」，用來打開塔的門。tiger、fever、pencil 都不能開門。
a huge candle「一根巨大的蠟燭」，就是熄滅的月亮蠟燭，用火柴點燃。homework、rainbow、cough 都不能點燃。
a tiny glass bottle full of moonlight「裝滿月光的小玻璃瓶」。lesson、monkey、fever 都不是玻璃做的容器。

passages.zh: 放學回家的路上，Lily 注意到兩間店之間有一扇奇怪的藍色門，她以前從沒看過。門旁邊有一個金色門鈴，她按下去，門就自己打開了。裡面是一座滿是發光樹木的森林。一隻戴紅帽子的小狐狸走向她：「歡迎！我們一直在等你。月亮蠟燭熄了，所以我們的森林變暗了，只有人類能再把它點亮。」狐狸給她一把銀鑰匙，帶她到一座高塔前。Lily 用鑰匙打開門，爬上樓梯，塔頂有一根巨大的蠟燭。她用火柴點燃它，整座森林都亮了起來，動物們歡呼著。狐狸送她一個裝滿月光的小玻璃瓶當謝禮。Lily 走出來時，又回到了街上，而那扇藍色的門已經不見了。

passages.title: 小狗叼走了鑰匙
passages.text: Every morning, Dad puts his car {1} on the small table by the door. But last Monday, they were gone. "I'm going to be late for work!" he shouted. We all started looking. Mom looked in the kitchen. My sister looked under the sofa. I looked in the bathroom and even checked the {2} on the shelf. Nothing. Then I noticed our puppy, Bobo, lying in his bed. He looked very happy and very {3}. Too quiet. I moved his blanket and found the keys, a sock, and an empty water {4}! Bobo had made his own treasure box. Dad laughed, even though he was late. That evening, he bought a small box with a lock for his keys. He also bought Bobo a toy shaped like a {5}. Now Bobo carries his own key around the house all day.

blanks.why: his car keys「他的車鑰匙」，不見了會讓他上班遲到。rivers、lessons、fevers 都不能放在桌上、跟上班有關。
check the towels on the shelf「檢查架子上的毛巾」。tigers、coughs、rainbows 都不會放在浴室的架子上。
very quiet. Too quiet.「很安靜，安靜得太過頭了」，後面重複 quiet。salty、sour、sweet 都是味道，不能形容狗的樣子。
an empty water bottle「一個空水瓶」。pencil、rainbow、fever 都不能和 water 組成「水的容器」。
a toy shaped like a key「鑰匙形狀的玩具」，後面說 Bobo 帶著自己的鑰匙。monkey、cough、lesson 都和後面 his own key 不合。

passages.zh: 每天早上，爸爸都把車鑰匙放在門邊的小桌子上。但上星期一，鑰匙不見了。「我上班要遲到了！」他大喊。我們全都開始找：媽媽找廚房，姊姊找沙發底下，我找浴室，連架子上的毛巾都翻了，什麼都沒有。接著我注意到我們的小狗 Bobo 躺在牠的床上，看起來很開心、很安靜——安靜得太過頭了。我掀開牠的毯子，發現了鑰匙、一隻襪子，還有一個空水瓶！Bobo 做了自己的寶物箱。雖然遲到了，爸爸還是笑了。那天晚上，他買了一個附鎖的小盒子放鑰匙，也買給 Bobo 一個鑰匙形狀的玩具。現在 Bobo 整天都叼著自己的「鑰匙」在家裡走來走去。

passages.title: 驚喜派對差點穿幫
passages.text: Next Friday is our teacher Ms. Chen's birthday, so our class planned a surprise party. Everyone had a job. Tom bought the cake, Amy brought thirty {1}, and I brought ten {2} of soda. We hid everything in the classroom closet. The class leader had the {3} to the closet, so it was safe. But on Thursday, Ms. Chen opened the closet to get a map. "Why is there a cake in here?" she asked. Everyone froze. Then Tom said, "It's for... science class! We're studying how cakes change in the heat." Ms. Chen looked at him, smiled, and closed the door. On Friday, we turned off the lights and waited. When she walked in, we shouted, "Surprise!" She laughed and said, "I knew it! But thank you for the science {4}." Then she wiped her happy tears with a {5} from her bag.

blanks.why: thirty candles「三十根蠟燭」插在生日蛋糕上。tigers、rivers、lessons 都不能帶來派對插在蛋糕上。
ten bottles of soda「十瓶汽水」。coughs、fevers、monkeys 都不能裝汽水。
the key to the closet「櫃子的鑰匙」，所以東西很安全。rainbow、pencil、homework 都不能鎖住櫃子。
the science lesson「自然課」，老師用 Tom 的藉口開玩笑。tiger、cough、river 都不能和 science 組成「課」。
wipe her tears with a towel「用毛巾擦眼淚」。fever、monkey、rainbow 都不能擦眼淚。

passages.zh: 下星期五是陳老師的生日，所以我們班計畫了一個驚喜派對。每個人都有工作：Tom 買蛋糕，Amy 帶三十根蠟燭，我帶十瓶汽水。我們把所有東西藏在教室的櫃子裡，班長有櫃子的鑰匙，所以很安全。但星期四，陳老師打開櫃子要拿地圖。「這裡面為什麼有蛋糕？」她問。大家都僵住了。接著 Tom 說：「那是……自然課用的！我們在研究蛋糕遇熱會怎麼變化。」陳老師看看他，笑了笑就把門關上。星期五，我們關燈等著，她一走進來，我們就大喊：「驚喜！」她笑著說：「我就知道！不過謝謝你們的自然課。」接著她用包包裡的毛巾擦掉開心的眼淚。

passages.title: 我們家的地震包
passages.text: After a big earthquake hit Hualien, our teacher asked every family to make an emergency bag. That weekend, my family sat on the living room floor and made ours together. First, Dad put in six {1} of water. "People need water most after an earthquake," he said. Mom added some cookies, a first-aid kit, and two small {2}. My sister wanted to put in her teddy bear, but Mom said no. Then I found some {3} and a box of matches in the kitchen. "Those are good if there's no electricity," Dad said. "But be careful with fire." We also put in a small {4} so we could listen to the news. Finally, Mom made copies of our house {5} and put them in a small pocket inside the bag. Now the bag sits next to the front door. I hope we never need it, but I feel safer knowing it's there.

blanks.why: six bottles of water「六瓶水」。tigers、lessons、coughs 都不能裝水。
two small towels「兩條小毛巾」，放進緊急包裡。rivers（河）、fevers（發燒）、rainbows（彩虹）都不能放進包包。
candles and matches「蠟燭和火柴」，停電時可以用，但要小心火。monkeys、rainbows、coughs 都和「火」無關。
a small radio to listen to the news「一台小收音機聽新聞」。tiger、homework、cough 都不能收聽新聞。
copies of our house keys「家裡鑰匙的備份」。fevers、rivers、lessons 都不能複製來開家門。

passages.zh: 花蓮發生大地震之後，老師要每個家庭準備一個緊急避難包。那個週末，我們全家坐在客廳地板上一起準備。首先，爸爸放了六瓶水。「地震之後人最需要的是水。」他說。媽媽加了一些餅乾、一個急救箱和兩條小毛巾。妹妹想放她的泰迪熊，但媽媽說不行。接著我在廚房找到幾根蠟燭和一盒火柴。「停電的時候這些很有用，」爸爸說，「但用火要小心。」我們也放了一台小收音機，這樣就能聽新聞。最後，媽媽把家裡的鑰匙多打了一副，放在包包裡的小口袋。現在這個包包就放在大門旁邊。我希望永遠用不到它，但知道它在那裡，我覺得比較安心。

passages.title: 校慶鬼屋的門鈴
passages.text: For the school fair, our class made a haunted house in the classroom. We covered the windows with black paper and turned on a few electric {1} so the room was dark and scary. At the door, we put an old {2}. When visitors pressed it, it played a creepy laugh. Inside, I hid behind a curtain with a wet {3}. When people walked by, I touched their arms with it. They screamed every time! My friend Ken stood at the end of the dark path. He held a {4} of fake blood and smiled at people. At three o'clock, the principal came in. When I touched his arm with the wet towel, he jumped so high that he hit the lamp. Then he laughed and said, "Best haunted house in the school!" Our class won first {5}, and we celebrated with bubble tea.

blanks.why: turn on electric candles「打開電子蠟燭」，讓教室又暗又恐怖。lessons、rivers、fevers 都不能打開發光。
an old doorbell at the door「門口裝一個舊門鈴」，按下去會播放笑聲。tiger、cough、pencil 都不能按來發出聲音。
a wet towel「一條濕毛巾」，用來碰客人的手臂。rainbow、monkey、homework 都不能拿來碰人。
a bottle of fake blood「一瓶假血」。fever、river、lesson 都不能裝東西。
win first prize「得到第一名（首獎）」。tiger、cough、rainbow 都不能和 win first 搭配表示得獎。

passages.zh: 校慶時，我們班在教室裡做了一間鬼屋。我們用黑紙把窗戶遮住，打開幾根電子蠟燭，讓教室又暗又可怕。門口裝了一個舊門鈴，客人一按就會播放恐怖的笑聲。在裡面，我拿著一條濕毛巾躲在簾子後面，有人經過時就用它碰他們的手臂，每個人都會尖叫！我朋友 Ken 站在黑暗通道的盡頭，拿著一瓶假血對大家微笑。三點時，校長進來了。我用濕毛巾碰他的手臂時，他嚇得跳很高，還撞到了燈。接著他笑著說：「全校最棒的鬼屋！」我們班得了第一名，還喝珍奶慶祝。

passages.title: 失物招領箱的祕密
passages.text: At the end of every semester, our school puts everything from the lost-and-found box on a long table. Students can come and take back their things. This year, the table was full. There were twenty water {1}, fifteen jackets, and more than ten sports {2}. There was also a set of {3} with a little cat on the key chain. Nobody took them for a week. Then our P.E. teacher saw them and shouted, "My keys! I've been looking for them since September!" Everyone laughed. The strangest thing on the table was a big pink {4} shaped like a cake. Nobody knew who it belonged to. In the end, our teacher put it on her desk. "If no one takes it, I'll use it for my birthday," she said. Now I {5} the lost-and-found box every month, because you never know what you'll find there.

blanks.why: twenty water bottles「二十個水瓶」。coughs、rivers、tigers 都不能放在失物招領桌上。
sports towels「運動毛巾」。fevers、lessons、monkeys 都不會被遺失放在桌上。
a set of keys with a key chain「一串掛著鑰匙圈的鑰匙」，後面體育老師說「我的鑰匙」。rainbows、coughs、tigers 都不能掛在鑰匙圈上。
a big pink candle shaped like a cake「做成蛋糕形狀的粉紅蠟燭」，老師要在生日用。river、homework、pencil 都不能做成蛋糕形狀在生日點。
check the box「檢查失物招領箱」。cry、sleep、fall 都是不及物動詞，不能直接接受詞 the box。

passages.zh: 每學期末，學校都會把失物招領箱裡的東西擺在一張長桌上，讓學生來拿回自己的東西。今年桌子滿滿的：有二十個水瓶、十五件外套，還有十幾條運動毛巾。還有一串鑰匙，鑰匙圈上有一隻小貓，一個星期都沒人拿。後來體育老師看到了，大叫：「我的鑰匙！我從九月就在找了！」大家都笑了。桌上最奇怪的東西是一根做成蛋糕形狀的大粉紅蠟燭，沒人知道是誰的。最後老師把它放在她桌上：「如果沒人拿，我生日就用它。」現在我每個月都會去看看失物招領箱，因為你永遠不知道會在那裡發現什麼。

passages.title: 小偵探找鑰匙
passages.text: My cousin Andy loves Detective Conan. He watches it every day and wants to be a detective. Last Sunday, Grandma couldn't find the {1} to her jewelry box. "Don't worry, Grandma," Andy said. "I'll solve this case!" He put on Grandpa's hat and looked around the house with a magnifying glass. First, he checked the bathroom. There was a wet {2} on the floor. "Someone took a shower this morning," he said. Then he looked at the kitchen table. There was an empty {3} of soy sauce and some rice. "Grandma cooked lunch," he said. Grandma laughed. "Yes, I know. I did all of that." Then the {4} rang. It was the {5}, Mrs. Lin. "Did you leave this at my house yesterday?" she asked. In her hand was the little key! Andy looked at it and said, "I knew it. The case is closed."

blanks.why: the key to her jewelry box「她珠寶盒的鑰匙」。river、fever、lesson 都不能打開盒子。
a wet towel on the floor「地上一條濕毛巾」，推理出有人早上洗過澡。tiger、pencil、cough 都不能證明有人洗澡。
an empty bottle of soy sauce「一個空的醬油瓶」。monkey、rainbow、homework 都不能裝醬油。
the doorbell rang「門鈴響了」，是鄰居來了。lesson、fever、river 都不會響。
the neighbor, Mrs. Lin「鄰居林太太」。lesson、pencil、rainbow 都不是人，不能說話、按門鈴。

passages.zh: 我表弟 Andy 很愛《名偵探柯南》，他每天都看，想當偵探。上星期天，阿嬤找不到她珠寶盒的鑰匙。「阿嬤別擔心，」Andy 說，「我來破這個案子！」他戴上阿公的帽子，拿著放大鏡在家裡四處查看。首先，他檢查浴室，地上有一條濕毛巾。「今天早上有人洗過澡。」他說。接著他看看廚房的桌子，上面有一個空醬油瓶和一些飯。「阿嬤煮了午餐。」他說。阿嬤笑了：「對啊，我知道，那些都是我做的。」這時門鈴響了，是鄰居林太太。「你昨天是不是把這個忘在我家？」她問。她手上拿的正是那把小鑰匙！Andy 看著它說：「我就知道。結案了。」

passages.title: 北投溫泉的小毛巾
passages.text: During winter vacation, my family went to a hot spring in Beitou. Before we went in, a staff member gave each of us a small white {1} and a {2} for a locker. "You must wash your body before you go into the water," she said. "And don't put the towel in the hot spring." My little brother didn't listen. He put his towel on his head like a hat and jumped into the water. The towel fell in! An old man next to us laughed and said, "In Japan, people also put towels on their heads, but they never let them fall in." My brother's face turned as red as a tomato. After the hot spring, we were very {3}, so Dad bought us {4} of cold milk. It was the best milk I've ever had. That night, I slept like a baby. Hot springs are great for your body and your {5}.

blanks.why: a small white towel「一條小白毛巾」，泡溫泉時用。river、lesson、fever 都不能發給客人帶著。
a key for a locker「置物櫃的鑰匙」。tiger、cough、rainbow 都不能打開置物櫃。
very thirsty「很渴」，所以爸爸買牛奶。honest、polite、lazy 都不是泡完溫泉後想喝東西的原因。
bottles of cold milk「幾瓶冰牛奶」。coughs、fevers、lessons 都不能裝牛奶。
good for your body and your mind「對身體和心靈都很好」。pencil、monkey、river 都不能和 body 並列表示身心。

passages.zh: 寒假時，我們全家去北投泡溫泉。進去之前，工作人員給我們每人一條小白毛巾和一把置物櫃的鑰匙。「進水裡之前要先把身體洗乾淨，」她說，「而且毛巾不能放進溫泉裡。」我弟弟沒在聽，他把毛巾放在頭上當帽子，然後跳進水裡——毛巾掉進去了！旁邊一位老先生笑著說：「在日本，大家也會把毛巾放在頭上，但從來不會讓它掉進去。」弟弟的臉紅得像番茄。泡完溫泉後我們都很渴，爸爸買了幾瓶冰牛奶給我們，那是我喝過最好喝的牛奶。那天晚上我睡得像嬰兒一樣。溫泉對身體和心靈都很好。

passages.title: 簽名會上的毛巾
passages.text: Mina is a big fan of Jay, the main singer of the K-pop group Sky Five. Last month, she went to a fan sign event in Taipei. She brought a photo of Jay, a small gift, and a {1} of his favorite drink, lemon tea. When it was her turn, she was so nervous that her hands were shaking. Jay smiled and signed her photo. Then he noticed that her face was wet with sweat because the room was hot. He took a clean {2} from the table and gave it to her. "Here, use this," he said. Mina almost cried. She took the towel home and never used it again. She keeps it in a box with a little {3}, so her little brother can't touch it. Every night, she lights a small {4} that smells like lemon and looks at her photo. "It's the best {5} I've ever gotten," she says.

blanks.why: a bottle of lemon tea「一瓶檸檬茶」。tiger、lesson、cough 都不能裝飲料。
a clean towel「一條乾淨的毛巾」，給她擦汗。river、fever、pencil 都不能擦汗。
a box with a little key「有小鑰匙可以鎖的盒子」，弟弟才碰不到。rainbow、monkey、cough 都不能鎖住盒子。
light a small candle that smells like lemon「點一根檸檬香味的小蠟燭」。lesson、river、tiger 都不能點燃。
the best gift I've ever gotten「我收過最棒的禮物」。fever、cough、homework 都不能用「收到」來形容她珍惜的東西。

passages.zh: Mina 是韓團 Sky Five 主唱 Jay 的超級粉絲。上個月，她去台北參加簽名會。她帶了一張 Jay 的照片、一份小禮物，還有一瓶他最喜歡的飲料：檸檬茶。輪到她的時候，她緊張到手都在發抖。Jay 微笑著在她的照片上簽名，接著他注意到她滿臉是汗，因為會場很熱。他從桌上拿了一條乾淨的毛巾給她：「來，用這個。」Mina 差點哭出來。她把毛巾帶回家，再也沒用過。她把毛巾放在一個有小鑰匙的盒子裡，這樣弟弟就碰不到。每天晚上，她都會點一根檸檬香味的小蠟燭，看著她的照片。「這是我收過最棒的禮物。」她說。

passages.title: 阿公的鑰匙謎語
passages.text: My grandpa loves riddles. Every time we visit him, he has a new one for us. Last Sunday, I rang his {1}, and he opened the door with a big smile. "Here's today's riddle," he said. "What has many keys but can't open a single door?" I thought about the {2} in my pocket. Then I thought about Grandpa's car. Nothing made sense. My sister looked around the living room and saw his old {3} in the corner. "A piano!" she shouted. "Right!" Grandpa said. "Now here's a harder one. What gets wetter and wetter the more it dries?" We thought for ten minutes. Then I went to the bathroom and saw a {4} on the wall. "A towel!" I said. Grandpa gave us each a {5} of chocolate milk as a prize. "Next week," he said, "I'll have a riddle about candles. Get ready!"

blanks.why: ring his doorbell「按他家門鈴」，接著他來開門。river、lesson、fever 都不能按。
the keys in my pocket「口袋裡的鑰匙」，謎題在問「鑰匙」。coughs、tigers、rainbows 都不能放在口袋裡。
his old piano「他的舊鋼琴」：鋼琴有很多「鍵」（keys），卻打不開門。cough、fever、rainbow 都不能放在客廳角落、也沒有琴鍵。
a towel on the wall「掛在牆上的毛巾」：毛巾越擦乾東西，自己就越濕。pencil、river、lesson 都不能用來擦乾。
a bottle of chocolate milk「一瓶巧克力牛奶」當獎品。tiger、homework、cough 都不能裝牛奶。

passages.zh: 我阿公很愛謎語，每次我們去看他，他都有新的謎語。上星期天，我按了他家的門鈴，他笑咪咪地開門說：「今天的謎語來了：什麼東西有很多『鍵』（鑰匙），卻一扇門都打不開？」我想了想口袋裡的鑰匙，又想了想阿公的車，都說不通。妹妹環顧客廳，看到角落那台舊鋼琴。「鋼琴！」她大喊。「答對了！」阿公說，「再來一題比較難的：什麼東西越擦乾東西，自己就越濕？」我們想了十分鐘，後來我去浴室，看到牆上掛著一條毛巾。「毛巾！」我說。阿公給我們每人一瓶巧克力牛奶當獎品。「下星期，」他說，「我會出一題跟蠟燭有關的謎語，準備好喔！」

passages.title: 燭光下的中秋頂樓
passages.text: On the night of the Moon Festival, my whole family was having a barbecue on our building's roof. Suddenly, all the lights in the building went out. "Oh no, the meat in the fridge!" Mom said. Dad went downstairs to get some {1} and came back with a box of them. We put them on the table, and they looked beautiful under the moon. My uncle opened a {2} of apple juice, and we all had a glass. My little cousin spilled her juice on her dress, so Grandma cleaned it with a {3}. Then we heard a noise. It was our neighbor ringing the {4} downstairs. She had lost her {5} in the dark and couldn't get into her apartment. We invited her up to the roof. She brought mooncakes, and we all ate together. When the lights came back on, nobody wanted to go home.

blanks.why: get some candles「拿一些蠟燭」，停電時點在桌上。tigers、lessons、fevers 都不能裝在盒子裡拿上來點。
open a bottle of apple juice「開一瓶蘋果汁」。rainbow、cough、river 都不能裝果汁。
clean it with a towel「用毛巾擦乾淨」。homework、fever、monkey 都不能擦衣服。
ring the doorbell「按門鈴」。pencil、tiger、lesson 都不能按。
lose her keys in the dark「在黑暗中弄丟鑰匙」，所以進不了公寓。rivers、coughs、lessons 都不能開門。

passages.zh: 中秋節晚上，我們全家在大樓頂樓烤肉。突然，整棟大樓的燈都熄了。「糟了，冰箱裡的肉！」媽媽說。爸爸下樓去拿蠟燭，帶回了一整盒。我們把蠟燭放在桌上，在月光下看起來好美。舅舅開了一瓶蘋果汁，每個人都喝了一杯。小表妹把果汁灑在洋裝上，阿嬤用毛巾幫她擦乾淨。接著我們聽到一個聲音：是鄰居在樓下按門鈴。她在黑暗中弄丟了鑰匙，進不了她的公寓。我們邀請她上頂樓，她帶來了月餅，大家一起吃。電來了之後，沒有人想回家。

passages.title: 過年大掃除的寶藏
passages.text: Every year before Chinese New Year, my family cleans the whole house. This year, my job was the bathroom and the hallway. In the bathroom, I washed all the {1} and threw away three empty shampoo {2}. In the hallway, I cleaned the dusty {3} by the front door. Then I found an old wooden box behind the shoe cabinet. It was locked. "Dad, do you know what this is?" I asked. Dad looked surprised. He went to his desk and came back with a small, old {4}. Inside the box were letters that Dad wrote to Mom before they got married! There was also a short red {5} from their first dinner together. Mom read one of the letters and laughed until she cried. "You were so romantic back then," she said. Dad's face turned red. Cleaning has never been so much fun.

blanks.why: wash all the towels「洗所有毛巾」，在浴室裡。tigers、rivers、coughs 都不能洗。
empty shampoo bottles「空的洗髮精瓶子」。fevers、lessons、monkeys 都不能和 shampoo 組成容器。
clean the dusty doorbell by the front door「擦大門旁積灰的門鈴」。rainbow、homework、cough 都不會裝在門邊。
a small old key「一把小小的舊鑰匙」，打開上鎖的盒子。river、fever、lesson 都不能開鎖。
a short red candle from their first dinner「第一次約會晚餐的紅蠟燭」。pencil、tiger、cough 都不能在晚餐點。

passages.zh: 每年過年前，我們全家都會大掃除。今年我負責浴室和走廊。在浴室裡，我洗了所有毛巾，丟掉三個空的洗髮精瓶子。在走廊，我擦了大門旁邊積滿灰塵的門鈴。接著我在鞋櫃後面發現一個舊木盒，它是鎖著的。「爸，你知道這是什麼嗎？」我問。爸爸看起來很驚訝，他走到書桌，拿回一把小小的舊鑰匙。盒子裡是爸爸在結婚前寫給媽媽的信！還有一根短短的紅蠟燭，是他們第一次一起吃晚餐時用的。媽媽讀了一封信，笑到流眼淚。「你那時候好浪漫喔。」她說。爸爸的臉都紅了。打掃從來沒有這麼好玩過。

passages.title: 露營車的鑰匙
passages.text: Last spring, my family rented a camper van and drove to Taitung. On the first night, we parked near the sea. Dad lit a {1} in a glass jar and put it on the table outside. We cooked noodles and watched the waves. After dinner, my sister and I took a walk on the beach. When we came back, Dad was looking everywhere. "Where are the van {2}?" he said. We looked under the seats, in the kitchen, and even in our water {3}. Nothing. Then Mom remembered something. "You used a beach {4} to dry your hands after cooking," she said. Dad shook the towel, and the keys fell out onto the sand. Everyone laughed. "This van needs a {5}," my sister said, "so the keys can ring when they're lost!" We didn't get one, but Dad kept the keys around his neck for the rest of the trip.

blanks.why: light a candle in a glass jar「在玻璃罐裡點一根蠟燭」。tiger、cough、lesson 都不能點燃。
the van keys「露營車的鑰匙」不見了。rivers、fevers、rainbows 都不能讓車子發動。
look in our water bottles「連水瓶裡都找了」。pencils、monkeys、coughs 都不能和 water 組成可以往裡面看的容器。
a beach towel to dry your hands「用海灘巾擦手」，鑰匙就裹在毛巾裡。lesson、homework、fever 都不能擦手。
This van needs a doorbell.「這台車需要一個門鈴」，妹妹開玩笑說門鈴會響。river、tiger、cough 都不能裝在車上「響」。

passages.zh: 去年春天，我們全家租了一台露營車開到台東。第一天晚上，我們把車停在海邊。爸爸在玻璃罐裡點了一根蠟燭，放在外面的桌上。我們煮麵、看海浪。晚餐後，我和妹妹去海灘散步。回來時，爸爸正到處找東西：「露營車的鑰匙在哪裡？」我們找了座椅底下、廚房，甚至連水瓶裡都看了，什麼都沒有。接著媽媽想起一件事：「你煮完飯有用海灘巾擦手。」爸爸甩一甩毛巾，鑰匙就掉到沙子上。大家都笑了。「這台車需要一個門鈴，」妹妹說，「這樣鑰匙不見的時候就會響了！」我們沒有裝門鈴，但接下來的旅程，爸爸都把鑰匙掛在脖子上。
